attachments.dropToAttach.description: Overlay shown across a message box while the person drags files over it: releasing them there attaches them to the message being written.

attachments.remove.description: Tooltip of the small × button on a file waiting to be sent in the message box: takes that file off the message.

attachments.removeNamed.description: Accessible name of the × button on a file waiting to be sent in the message box. {{file}} is the file's name.

attachments.removeUnnamed.description: Accessible name of the × button on a file waiting to be sent in the message box. Used for a file with no name; "file" is written as it has always been shown.

attachments.refusedMore_one.description: Error under the message box when several chosen files were refused. {{reason}} is a complete sentence saying why the first one was refused, kept first; {{count}} is how many other files were also left out.

attachments.refusedMore_other.description: Error under the message box when several chosen files were refused. {{reason}} is a complete sentence saying why the first one was refused, kept first; {{count}} is how many other files were also left out.

friends.error.requestFailed.description: Error shown when a friend action failed and the server gave no explanation. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

friends.error.cannotAdd.text: You can’t add @{{username}} as a friend right now.
friends.error.cannotAdd.description: Error shown when a friend request could not be sent to this person. {{username}} is their username; keep the @ in front of it.

friends.error.cannotAddUnnamed.text: You can’t add @them as a friend right now.
friends.error.cannotAddUnnamed.description: Error shown when a friend request could not be sent and the person's username is not known. "@them" stands in for the username in English; write whatever reads naturally for an unnamed person, with or without the @.

friends.error.updateFailed.text: Couldn’t update this friendship. Check your connection and try again.
friends.error.updateFailed.description: Error shown when adding, accepting, declining or removing a friend failed, usually because the network is down.

friends.button.requested.description: Label of the friend button on a person's profile after you sent them a friend request that they have not answered yet. Pressing it opens a menu to cancel the request.

friends.button.requestedMenu.description: Accessible name of the friend button while your friend request to this person is unanswered: states that the request was sent and that pressing opens more options. {{username}} is their username; keep the @.

friends.button.cancelRequest.description: Menu item under the "Requested" friend button: withdraws the friend request you sent to this person.

friends.button.cancelRequestConfirm.description: Confirmation question before withdrawing a friend request you sent. {{username}} is the person it was sent to; keep the @.

friends.button.accept.description: Button beside a person who sent you a friend request: accepts it, making you friends.

friends.button.decline.description: Button beside a person who sent you a friend request: turns the request down.

friends.button.friends.description: Label of the friend button on the profile of a person you are already friends with. It is a state, not an action; pressing it opens a menu to unfriend.

friends.button.friendsMenu.description: Accessible name of the friend button for a person you are friends with: states the friendship and that pressing opens more options. {{username}} is their username; keep the @.

friends.button.unfriend.description: Menu item under the "Friends" button: ends your friendship with this person.

friends.button.unfriendConfirm.description: Confirmation question before ending a friendship. {{username}} is the friend; keep the @. The second sentence says the other person gets no notice.

friends.button.addFriend.description: Button on a person's profile or search result: sends them a friend request.

friends.search.failed.text: Search isn’t working right now. Check your connection and try again.
friends.search.failed.description: Note under the friend search box on your profile when the search request failed.

friends.search.searching.description: Note under the friend search box while results for the typed username are being fetched.

friends.search.noMatch.description: Note under the friend search box when no person's username matches. {{query}} is what the person typed.

friends.search.label.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the search box on your profile where you type a username to find people to add as friends.

imageViewer.imageName.description: Accessible name of the full-screen picture viewer and of the picture in it when the picture has no name of its own. A noun.

imageViewer.openOriginal.description: Link at the top of the full-screen picture viewer, for a picture hosted on another site: opens the original file in a new browser tab.

imageViewer.downloading.description: Label of the download button in the full-screen picture viewer while the picture is being saved.

imageViewer.tapToSave.description: Label of the download button in the full-screen picture viewer when the phone needs one more tap before it will open its save or share sheet.

imageViewer.download.description: Button at the top of the full-screen picture viewer: saves the picture to the device.

imageSave.saved_one.description: Brief confirmation after pictures from a message were saved to the phone. {{count}} is how many pictures. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

imageSave.saved_other.description: Brief confirmation after pictures from a message were saved to the phone. {{count}} is how many pictures.

imageSave.failed.description: Brief error shown when saving a picture from a message to the device failed.

imageSave.updateApp.text: This version of the Homeroom app can’t save pictures. Update the app to save them.
imageSave.updateApp.description: Brief message shown when someone taps Download on a picture inside an older Homeroom mobile app that has no way to save pictures to the phone.

imageSave.menuDownload_one.description: Item in a message's actions menu: saves the pictures attached to that message to the device. {{count}} is how many pictures the message has. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

imageSave.menuDownload_other.description: Item in a message's actions menu: saves the pictures attached to that message to the device. {{count}} is how many pictures the message has.

actions.toolbar.description: Accessible name of the small toolbar that appears on a message (react, reply, save, more), and of the same actions as a sheet on a phone.

actions.removeReaction.description: Accessible name of a quick-reaction button on a message you already reacted to with that emoji: pressing it takes your reaction back. {{emoji}} is the emoji's English name, for example "thumbs up".

actions.reactWith.description: Accessible name of a quick-reaction button on a message: adds that emoji as your reaction. {{emoji}} is the emoji's English name, for example "thumbs up".

actions.addReaction.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the smiley button on a message: opens the emoji picker to choose a reaction.

actions.reply.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the arrow button on a message: starts a reply to that message. A verb.

actions.unsaveMessage.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a message you saved: removes it from your saved items.

actions.saveMessage.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a message: keeps the message in your notifications so you can find it later.

actions.savedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a message that is already saved.

actions.saveTooltip.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a message that is not saved yet. Saved messages are listed in the notifications panel.

actions.moreActions.description: Accessible name of the "…" button on a message and of the menu it opens (copy, edit, delete and so on).

actions.more.description: Tooltip of the "…" button on a message that opens the menu of further actions.

actions.sheet.close.description: Accessible name of the dimmed background behind the message actions sheet on a phone: tapping it closes the sheet.

actions.sheet.previewAttachment.description: Shown after the author's name at the top of the message actions sheet in place of the message's words, when the message is only a file or picture. A noun.

clipboard.copied.description: Brief confirmation shown after something from a message was copied to the clipboard.

clipboard.failed.text: Couldn’t copy. Your browser blocked the clipboard.
clipboard.failed.description: Brief error shown when copying a message's text or link to the clipboard failed.

emoji.category.smileys.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: smiling and other faces.

emoji.category.people.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: people and hand gestures.

emoji.category.hearts.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: heart emoji.

emoji.category.nature.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: animals, plants and weather.

emoji.category.food.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: food and drinks.

emoji.category.activities.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: sports, games and celebrations.

emoji.category.objects.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: vehicles, places and everyday objects.

emoji.category.symbols.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: signs, shapes, arrows and flags.

emoji.category.recent.description: Name of the first section of the emoji picker: the emoji this person reacted with most recently.

emoji.picker.name.description: Accessible name of the emoji picker that opens from a message.

emoji.picker.search.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the search box at the top of the emoji picker.

emoji.picker.categories.description: Accessible name of the row of icon tabs in the emoji picker that jump to each section.

emoji.picker.matching.description: Accessible name of the grid of search results in the emoji picker.

emoji.picker.noMatch.description: Shown in the emoji picker when the search finds nothing. {{query}} is what the person typed.

emoji.picker.hint.description: Hint in the footer of the emoji picker while no emoji is hovered or focused.

thread.activity.what_one.description: Heading of the card in a conversation that shows new replies made inside a thread under an older message. {{count}} is how many replies the card shows. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

thread.activity.what_other.description: Heading of the card in a conversation that shows new replies made inside a thread under an older message. {{count}} is how many replies the card shows.

thread.activity.rootDeleted.description: Shown on the thread-replies card in place of the thread's first message when that message was deleted.

thread.activity.rootNoText.description: Shown alone, in its own muted element beside the heading "Replied in thread", on the card of replies made in a thread: stands in for the thread's first message when that message has no words (for example only a picture). It is not joined to the heading in code; it is lower case in English because nothing is capitalized there.

thread.activity.open_one.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, {{message}} is the text of the thread's first message and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

thread.activity.open_other.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, {{message}} is the text of the thread's first message and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply.

thread.activity.openDeleted_one.text: Replied in thread: Message deleted, {{time}}. Open thread
thread.activity.openDeleted_one.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card when the thread's first message was deleted: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

thread.activity.openDeleted_other.text: {{count}} replies in thread: Message deleted, {{time}}. Open thread
thread.activity.openDeleted_other.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card when the thread's first message was deleted: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply.

thread.activity.openNoText_one.text: Replied in thread: a message, {{time}}. Open thread
thread.activity.openNoText_one.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card when the thread's first message has no words: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

thread.activity.openNoText_other.text: {{count}} replies in thread: a message, {{time}}. Open thread
thread.activity.openNoText_other.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card when the thread's first message has no words: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply.

thread.activity.attachment.description: Shown on the thread-replies card in place of a reply's words when the reply is only a file or picture. A noun.

thread.summary.count_one.description: Label on the chip under a message that has a thread: how many replies the thread holds. {{count}} is that number.

thread.summary.count_other.description: Label on the chip under a message that has a thread: how many replies the thread holds. {{count}} is that number.

thread.summary.openLastFromAt_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, {{username}} wrote the latest one (keep the @) and {{when}} is how long ago, for example "5m ago".

thread.summary.openLastFromAt_other.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, {{username}} wrote the latest one (keep the @) and {{when}} is how long ago, for example "5m ago".

thread.summary.openLastFromUnknownAt_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, Used on the Messages screen when the username of the person who replied last is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromUnknownAt_oth.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, Used on the Messages screen when the username of the person who replied last is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromSomeoneAt_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, Used in an app's chat when nobody can be named for the last reply; "@someone" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromSomeoneAt_oth.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, Used in an app's chat when nobody can be named for the last reply; "@someone" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFrom_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{username}} wrote the latest one (keep the @).

thread.summary.openLastFrom_other.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{username}} wrote the latest one (keep the @).

thread.summary.openLastFromUnknown_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and Used on the Messages screen when the username of the person who replied last is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromUnknown_other.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and Used on the Messages screen when the username of the person who replied last is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromSomeone_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and Used in an app's chat when nobody can be named for the last reply; "@someone" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromSomeone_other.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and Used in an app's chat when nobody can be named for the last reply; "@someone" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastAt_one.description: Accessible name of the compact thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{when}} is how long ago the latest one was written, for example "5m ago".

thread.summary.openLastAt_other.description: Accessible name of the compact thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{when}} is how long ago the latest one was written, for example "5m ago".

thread.summary.open_one.description: Accessible name of the compact thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies.

thread.summary.open_other.description: Accessible name of the compact thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies.

thread.summary.attachment.description: Shown on the thread chip in place of the latest reply's words when that reply is only a file or picture. A noun.

thread.summary.lastReply.description: Shown on the compact thread chip under a message. {{when}} is how long ago the latest reply was written, for example "5m ago".

list.dot.description: Joins two short independent facts on one status line, for example "Building · 5m so far". {{first}} and {{second}} are each already a complete translated phrase. Use the separator your language uses between such facts.

approval.list.comma.description: Joins people in a list of who has yet to approve a change, before the final "and" or "or". {{first}} is the list so far and {{second}} is the next person. The items are account names (@ada), and sometimes the reader or a count of unnamed people, which have entries of their own for each place a list can stand.

approval.list.and.description: Ends a list of the people who all have yet to approve a change, as in "you, @ada and @cy". {{first}} is everyone before the last item and {{last}} is the last item. The items are account names (@ada), and sometimes the reader or a count of unnamed people, which have entries of their own for each place a list can stand.

approval.list.or.description: Ends a list of people any one of whom could give a missing approval, as in "@ada, @ben or 2 others". {{first}} is everyone before the last item and {{last}} is the last item. The items are account names (@ada), and sometimes the reader or a count of unnamed people, which have entries of their own for each place a list can stand.

approval.list.from.you.description: An item in a list of the people whose approval a change is waiting for: the reader themselves. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position. When the reader is the only one, a whole sentence is used instead ("Waiting for approval from you").

approval.list.from.more_one.description: Last item in a list of people who all have yet to approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position.

approval.list.from.more_other.description: Last item in a list of people who all have yet to approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position.

approval.list.from.others_one.description: Last item in a list of people any one of whom could approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position.

approval.list.from.others_other.description: Last item in a list of people any one of whom could approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position.

approval.list.subject.more_one.description: Last item in a list of people who all have yet to approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list is the subject of a sentence such as "It goes live when @ada, @cy and 2 more approve too."; use the form your language needs for a subject.

approval.list.subject.more_other.description: Last item in a list of people who all have yet to approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list is the subject of a sentence such as "It goes live when @ada, @cy and 2 more approve too."; use the form your language needs for a subject.

approval.needs_one.description: Status line on a change that is ready: how many approvals it still needs and who can give them. {{count}} is the number of approvals; {{people}} is a list of people joined with "or", such as "@ada or @ben". {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

approval.needs_other.description: Status line on a change that is ready: how many approvals it still needs and who can give them. {{count}} is the number of approvals; {{people}} is a list of people joined with "or", such as "@ada or @ben".

approval.needsMore_one.description: Status line on a change that already has some approvals: how many more it needs and who can give them. {{count}} is the number still missing; {{people}} is a list of people joined with "or". {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

approval.needsMore_other.description: Status line on a change that already has some approvals: how many more it needs and who can give them. {{count}} is the number still missing; {{people}} is a list of people joined with "or".

approval.waiting.description: Status line on a change that is ready, when every listed person must approve. {{people}} is a list joined with "and": account names such as @ada, possibly the reader ("you") first and a count of unnamed people last, each already in the form that follows "from". When the reader is the only one, "Waiting for approval from you" is used instead.

approval.waitingYou.description: Status line on a change that is ready, when the reader's own approval is the only one it is waiting for. No full stop.

bot.job.firstVersion.description: Name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing: building the first version of a project. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.job.firstVersionUnnamed.description: Name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing: building the first version of a project. Used when the project cannot be named; "A project" is written as the line has always shown it.

bot.job.request.description: Name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing: a numbered request in a project. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} is the request number; keep the # before the number.

bot.job.requestUnnamed.description: Name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing: a numbered request in a project. Used when the project cannot be named; "A project" is written as the line has always shown it. {{number}} is the request's number; keep the #.

bot.job.requestTitled.description: Full name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing. {{project}} is the project's name, {{number}} the request number (keep the #) and {{title}} the request's title as its author wrote it.

bot.job.requestTitledUnnamed.description: Full name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing. Used when the project cannot be named; "A project" is written as the line has always shown it. {{number}} is the request's number and {{title}} its title.

bot.job.titled.description: Full name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing when the request has no number. {{project}} is the project's name and {{title}} the request's title as its author wrote it.

bot.job.titledUnnamed.description: Full name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing when the request has no number. Used when the project cannot be named; "A project" is written as the line has always shown it. {{title}} is the title of the work.

bot.job.unnamedProject.description: Stands in for a project's name on a Homeroom bot activity card when the name is not known.

bot.outcome.question.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot asked the person a question and is waiting for the answer. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.proposed.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built and waits for the group's approval. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.live.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built and now in use. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.closed.text: Built it. The change was closed
bot.outcome.closed.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change was built but then closed without going into use. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.blocked.text: Can’t build it as it’s written
bot.outcome.blocked.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the request cannot be built as it is worded. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.buildFailed.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the build did not complete. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.person.text: Left it for the group to decide
bot.outcome.person.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot left the decision to the group. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.empty.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot found nothing in the request to build. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.failed.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot could not finish reading the request. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.held.text: Ready, but held back for now
bot.outcome.held.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is ready but is being kept back for the moment. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.stopped.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the work was stopped before it finished. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.answer.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot answered a question on the change. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.revise.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot updated the change after feedback. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.checking.text: Built it. Checking it before you try it
bot.outcome.checking.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built and is being checked before the person can try it. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.needsLook.text: Built it, but it needs a look
bot.outcome.needsLook.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built but something in it needs the person's attention. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.goingLive.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built, approved and being put into use, when there is no release estimate to say instead. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.tone.done.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the work finished and nothing more is needed.

bot.tone.built.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the change has been built (past participle) and is waiting for a next step such as approval.

bot.tone.you.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the bot is waiting for the reader to answer or decide something.

bot.tone.ended.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the work ended without a change going into use.

bot.tone.trouble.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the work failed or was stopped before finishing.

bot.state.needsYou.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the request waits on the person reading it (a question, a plan to OK).

bot.state.ready.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the change it built is ready to try and waits for approval.

bot.state.testing.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the change is built and being tested before anyone tries it.

bot.state.approved.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the change was approved and is going live.

bot.state.live.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the change is live in the project.

bot.state.stopped.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the work stopped before it finished.

bot.state.waiting.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the bot is held back and will start later.

bot.state.line.question.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Needs you": the bot asked the person a question about the request.

bot.state.line.ready.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Ready to try": the change waits for people to approve it.

bot.state.line.goingLive.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Approved": the change is on its way to being live.

bot.state.line.live.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Live": the change is live in the project.

bot.state.line.needsLook.text: It’s built, but a person needs to look at it
bot.state.line.needsLook.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Stopped": the change was built but a person must look at it before anyone can try it.

bot.state.onHold.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the person's building time for this week is used up, so the work waits until Monday.

bot.state.line.onHold.text: Your building time for this week is used up
bot.state.line.onHold.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "On hold until Monday": why the work waits.

bot.state.line.stop.time.text: It took longer than I’m allowed
bot.state.line.stop.time.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Stopped": the bot (speaking as I) ran out of the time it may spend building.

bot.state.line.stop.restart.text: Homeroom restarted while I was building
bot.state.line.stop.restart.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Stopped": Homeroom restarted during the build. The bot speaks as I.

bot.state.line.stop.noChange.text: I ended up with no changes to show
bot.state.line.stop.noChange.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Stopped": the build produced no changes. The bot speaks as I.

bot.state.line.stop.unproposed.text: I couldn’t put it up for a vote
bot.state.line.stop.unproposed.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Stopped": the bot built the change but could not put it to the group's vote.

bot.state.line.stop.unproposedFirst.text: I built it but couldn’t put it live yet
bot.state.line.stop.unproposedFirst.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title for a project's first version, under the heading "Stopped": the bot built the first version but could not make it live. A first version needs no vote. The bot speaks as I.

bot.state.line.stop.noStart.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Stopped": the build never started. The bot speaks as I.

bot.state.line.stop.other.text: Something went wrong while I was building
bot.state.line.stop.other.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Stopped": the build failed for another reason. The bot speaks as I.

bot.state.line.heldPerApp.text: I’ll start when one of my changes on {{project}} is voted in or closed
bot.state.line.heldPerApp.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Waiting": the bot has as many changes up for a vote on this project as it may, and starts once one is decided. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.state.line.heldTotal.text: I’ll start when one of my changes across Homeroom is voted in or closed
bot.state.line.heldTotal.description: The line under a Homeroom bot activity card's title, under the heading "Waiting": the bot has as many changes up for a vote across all of Homeroom as it may, and starts once one is decided.

bot.strip.name.description: Accessible name of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the person's requests to the bot and where each stands.

bot.strip.activity.description: Label of the bar under the header of the chat with Homeroom bot that opens the activity drawer: the person's requests to the bot and where each stands.

bot.strip.summary.needs_one.description: Part of the summary line of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: how many requests wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

bot.strip.summary.needs_other.description: Part of the summary line of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: how many requests wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

bot.strip.summary.ready_one.description: Part of the summary line of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: how many changes the bot built are ready for the person to try. {{count}} is that number.

bot.strip.summary.ready_other.description: Part of the summary line of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: how many changes the bot built are ready for the person to try. {{count}} is that number.

bot.strip.summary.progress_one.description: Part of the summary line of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: how many requests the bot is working on now. {{count}} is that number.

bot.strip.summary.progress_other.description: Part of the summary line of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: how many requests the bot is working on now. {{count}} is that number.

bot.strip.summary.done_one.description: Part of the summary line of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: how many requests went live in the last day. {{count}} is that number. Counts every request that ended today: live, done another way, closed or stopped.

bot.strip.summary.done_other.description: Part of the summary line of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: how many requests ended today, since midnight. {{count}} is that number. Counts every request that ended today: live, done another way, closed or stopped.

bot.final.doneElsewhere.description: How a request the bot was working on ended, said on hover and to a screen reader beside its small status square: somebody else's change shipped what it asked for.

bot.strip.group.needs.description: Small heading over the rows of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot that wait on the person.

bot.strip.group.ready.description: Small heading over the rows of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot whose change is ready for the person to try.

bot.strip.group.progress.description: Small heading over the line of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot naming the requests the bot is working on now.

bot.strip.group.done.description: Heading of the activity drawer's group of requests that went live (or were closed) in the last day, in the chat with Homeroom bot.

bot.strip.firstVersion.description: Name of a project's first version on a row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot and on a news line in the chat with Homeroom bot. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.strip.requestNumber.description: Name of a request with no title on a row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot and on a news line in the chat with Homeroom bot. {{number}} is its number on the project's board, keep the #.

bot.strip.doing.reading.description: What Homeroom bot is doing on a request, in the In progress line of the activity drawer: reading it. Lower case, it follows the request's title in brackets.

bot.strip.doing.planning.description: What Homeroom bot is doing on a request, in the In progress line of the activity drawer: writing its plan. Lower case, it follows the request's title in brackets.

bot.strip.doing.building.description: What Homeroom bot is doing on a request, in the In progress line of the activity drawer: building it. Lower case, it follows the request's title in brackets.

bot.strip.doing.testing.description: What Homeroom bot is doing on a request, in the In progress line of the activity drawer: testing what it built. Lower case, it follows the request's title in brackets.

bot.strip.doing.queued.description: What Homeroom bot is doing on a request, in the In progress line of the activity drawer: the request waits its turn. Lower case, it follows the request's title in brackets.

bot.strip.doing.followingUp.description: What Homeroom bot is doing on a request, in the In progress line of the activity drawer: updating its change after replies. Lower case, it follows the request's title in brackets.

bot.strip.doing.goingLive.description: What Homeroom bot is doing on a request, in the In progress line of the activity drawer: its change is going live. Lower case, it follows the request's title in brackets.

bot.strip.doing.settingUp.description: What Homeroom bot is doing on a request, in the In progress line of the activity drawer: setting up a new project. Lower case, it follows the request's title in brackets.

bot.strip.state.needsAnswer.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot asked a question.

bot.strip.state.planReady.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot's plan waits for the person to say Build it.

bot.strip.state.needsDecision.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: a person has to decide something before the bot builds it.

bot.strip.state.stopped.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot's work on it stopped before it finished.

bot.strip.state.stoppedTime.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot's build stopped because it ran out of time.

bot.strip.state.blocked.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot needs more detail to build it.

bot.strip.state.empty.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot found nothing to build in it yet.

bot.strip.state.needsLook.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: a person has to look at the change before it can go on.

bot.strip.state.onHold.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the person's building time for this week is used up.

bot.strip.state.secrets.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: a new project waits for the person to add its secrets (keys and passwords it needs).

bot.strip.state.needsYou.description: Line under a request's title on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: when nothing more specific is known.

bot.strip.state.testing.description: Line under a request's title on a Ready to try row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the change is built and being tested before anyone tries it.

bot.strip.state.readyForYes.description: Line under a request's title on a Ready to try row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the person's approval would count.

bot.strip.state.waitingFor.description: Line under a request's title on a Ready to try row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: who still has to approve the change. {{who}} is one or more @names.

bot.strip.state.waitingApproval.description: Line under a request's title on a Ready to try row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the change waits for people to approve it.

bot.strip.state.live.description: Line under a request's title on a Done row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: its change is live.

bot.strip.state.closed.description: Line under a request's title on a Done row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: its change was closed without going live.

bot.strip.action.answer.description: Button on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: opens the request's thread at the bot's question.

bot.strip.action.buildIt.description: Button on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: opens the request's thread at the bot's plan, where Build it starts the build. "Build" is a verb.

bot.strip.action.decide.description: Button on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: opens the request's thread at what needs deciding.

bot.strip.action.tryAgain.description: Button on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: opens the request's thread at the message that stopped, with its Try again.

bot.strip.action.addDetail.description: Button on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: opens the request's thread to say more about what is wanted.

bot.strip.action.open.description: Button on a Needs you row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: opens the request's thread.

bot.strip.action.tryIt.description: Button on a Ready to try row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: opens a preview of the change.

bot.strip.action.approve.description: Button on a Ready to try row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot: the person's yes vote on the change.

bot.strip.approveStale.text: It changed since you looked. Try it again first.
bot.strip.approveStale.description: Shown under a Ready to try row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot when Approve was refused because the change was updated.

bot.strip.approveFailed.description: Shown under a Ready to try row of the activity drawer of the chat with Homeroom bot when Approve failed.

bot.news.started.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot (speaking as I) started working on the request. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.final.live.description: How a finished request ended, on its one-line row in the chat with Homeroom bot (after a green check): its change is live.

bot.final.goingLive.description: The same, after a green check: its change was approved and is on its way live.

bot.final.closed.description: The same: its change was closed without going live.

bot.final.person.description: How a finished request ended, on its one-line row in the chat with Homeroom bot (a person icon; read out and shown on hover): the bot stepped back and left it for a person, a decision it should not make or a change it could take no further.

bot.final.held.description: The same: the change was ready but held back by a limit, and nothing more came of it.

bot.final.stopped.description: The same: the bot’s work on it stopped before it finished.

bot.final.failed.description: The same, after a red cross: the bot could not finish building it.

bot.news.answer.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot asked the person a question about it. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.news.plan.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot's plan for it is ready. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.news.decision.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: the person has to decide something. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.news.detail.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot cannot build it as written. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.news.ready.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: the change the bot built is ready to try. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.news.stopped.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: the bot's work on it stopped. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.news.onHold.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: building time for this week is used up. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.news.slots.description: A row in the chat with Homeroom bot standing for one request, beside its title: the request is ready to build, but all of the project's slots for the bot's changes are in use, so it waits for one to free.

bot.news.doneElsewhere.description: A row in the chat with Homeroom bot standing for one request, beside its title: somebody else's change shipped what the request asked for, so the bot has nothing more to build.

bot.news.taken.description: A row in the chat with Homeroom bot standing for one request, beside its title: the bot had said it would build the request, but a person has taken it on since (their own change, or a claim), so the bot leaves it to them.

bot.news.live.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: its change is live. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.news.update.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row in the chat with Homeroom bot: other news about it. Sentence case: it is a line of its own.

bot.news.past.answer.description: Where a request stands, on the line under its title in a news row of the chat with Homeroom bot, when the question the bot asked no longer waits on the person (answered, or the request moved on). Past tense; sentence case.

bot.news.past.plan.description: The same line when the plan the bot sent no longer waits on the person. Past tense; sentence case.

bot.news.past.decision.description: The same line when the decision the bot asked for no longer waits on the person. Past tense; sentence case.

bot.news.past.detail.description: The same line when the bot's ask for more detail no longer waits on the person. Past tense; sentence case.

bot.news.past.ready.description: The same line when the change the bot built is no longer up for the person to try (it went live, was closed or was replaced). Past tense; sentence case.

bot.news.run.finished_one.description: Part of the chat with Homeroom bot's folded line of finished requests, in place of a strip of small status squares: how many of them ended fine (went live, was closed, was handed to a person). {{count}} is that number. Zero parts of the line are left out.

bot.news.run.finished_other.description: Part of the chat with Homeroom bot's folded line of finished requests, in place of a strip of small status squares: how many of them ended fine (went live, was closed, was handed to a person). {{count}} is that number. Zero parts of the line are left out.

bot.news.run.failed_one.description: Part of the chat with Homeroom bot's folded line of finished requests, in place of a strip of small status squares: how many of them went wrong. {{count}} is that number.

bot.news.run.failed_other.description: Part of the chat with Homeroom bot's folded line of finished requests, in place of a strip of small status squares: how many of them went wrong. {{count}} is that number.

bot.news.updates_one.description: End of the news line for a request's card in the chat with Homeroom bot: how many messages its thread holds; a tap opens it. {{count}} is that number.

bot.news.updates_other.description: End of the news line for a request's card in the chat with Homeroom bot: how many messages its thread holds; a tap opens it. {{count}} is that number.

bot.span.underMinute.description: A duration of less than one minute, shown where a length of time is given on a Homeroom bot card, as in "under a minute so far" or "took under a minute".

bot.span.minutes.description: A short duration in minutes on a Homeroom bot card. {{minutes}} is a number; "m" abbreviates minutes.

bot.span.hours.description: A short duration in whole hours on a Homeroom bot card. {{hours}} is a number; "h" abbreviates hours.

bot.span.hoursMinutes.description: A short duration in hours and minutes on a Homeroom bot card. {{hours}} and {{minutes}} are numbers; "h" and "m" abbreviate hours and minutes.

bot.span.days.description: A short duration in whole days on a Homeroom bot card. {{days}} is a number; "d" abbreviates days.

bot.span.daysHours.description: A short duration in days and hours on a Homeroom bot card. {{days}} and {{hours}} are numbers; "d" and "h" abbreviate days and hours.

bot.activity.typicalAbout_one.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a working Homeroom bot activity card, complete on its own: how long this kind of work usually takes. {{count}} is a number of minutes.

bot.activity.typicalAbout_other.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a working Homeroom bot activity card, complete on its own: how long this kind of work usually takes. {{count}} is a number of minutes.

bot.activity.typicalRange_one.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a working Homeroom bot activity card, complete on its own: the usual range of time this kind of work takes. {{from}} is the shorter number of minutes and {{count}} the longer.

bot.activity.typicalRange_other.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a working Homeroom bot activity card, complete on its own: the usual range of time this kind of work takes. {{from}} is the shorter number of minutes and {{count}} the longer.

bot.activity.soFar.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a working Homeroom bot activity card: how long the bot has been working. {{duration}} is a short duration such as "5m", "2h 5m" or "under a minute". Complete on its own; a middle dot joins it to the fact before it.

bot.activity.soFarAfterFirstVersion.text: {{duration}} so far, after waiting {{waited}} for the first version
bot.activity.soFarAfterFirstVersion.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a working Homeroom bot activity card: how long the bot has been working, and how long the request waited beforehand for the project's first version to be finished. {{duration}} and {{waited}} are short durations such as "5m" or "2h 5m". Complete on its own; a middle dot joins it to the fact before it.

bot.activity.soFarAfterTurn.text: {{duration}} so far, after waiting {{waited}} for its turn
bot.activity.soFarAfterTurn.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a working Homeroom bot activity card: how long the bot has been working, and how long the request waited in the bot's queue beforehand. {{duration}} and {{waited}} are short durations such as "5m" or "2h 5m". Complete on its own; a middle dot joins it to the fact before it.

bot.activity.took.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a finished Homeroom bot activity card: how long the work took. {{duration}} is a short duration such as "5m", "2h 5m" or "under a minute". Complete on its own; a middle dot joins it to the fact before it.

bot.activity.tookAfterFirstVersion.text: took {{duration}}, after waiting {{waited}} for the first version
bot.activity.tookAfterFirstVersion.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a finished Homeroom bot activity card: how long the work took, and how long the request waited beforehand for the project's first version. {{duration}} and {{waited}} are short durations such as "5m" or "2h 5m". Complete on its own; a middle dot joins it to the fact before it.

bot.activity.tookAfterTurn.text: took {{duration}}, after waiting {{waited}} for its turn
bot.activity.tookAfterTurn.description: One fact in the dot-separated status line of a finished Homeroom bot activity card: how long the work took, and how long the request waited in the bot's queue beforehand. {{duration}} and {{waited}} are short durations such as "5m" or "2h 5m". Complete on its own; a middle dot joins it to the fact before it.

bot.activity.ringStep.description: Tooltip of the progress ring on a Homeroom bot activity card: which step of the work is under way. {{step}} is the current step number and {{total}} the number of steps.

bot.activity.ringStepNamed.description: Tooltip of the progress ring on a Homeroom bot activity card. {{step}} is the current step number, {{total}} the number of steps and {{name}} what the step is called.

bot.activity.ringWorking.description: Tooltip of the spinning ring on a Homeroom bot activity card while the bot works and no step number is known. "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.activity.eyebrowStep.description: Small heading on a working Homeroom bot activity card. {{step}} is the current step number and {{total}} the number of steps.

bot.activity.eyebrowStepNamed.description: Small heading on a working Homeroom bot activity card: the step it is at, by name, then its number. {{name}} is what the step is called (for example Building), {{step}} the current step number and {{total}} the number of steps.

bot.activity.eyebrowWorking.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card while the bot works and no step number is known. "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.activity.eyebrowUnknown.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card whose progress is not known yet. A noun: the bot's activity.

bot.activity.statusWorking.description: Status line on a working Homeroom bot activity card when the bot has not said what exactly it is doing. "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.activity.youAsked.description: Title line of a Homeroom bot activity card. {{request}} is what the person asked the bot for, in their own words.

bot.activity.loadFailed.text: Couldn’t load how far along this is.
bot.activity.loadFailed.description: Error on a Homeroom bot activity card when its progress could not be fetched. A "Try again" button follows.

bot.activity.noProgress.text: No progress to show for this one.
bot.activity.noProgress.description: Shown on a Homeroom bot activity card when there is no progress record for that piece of work.

bot.activity.openChange.description: Link on a Homeroom bot activity card: opens the page of the change the bot built. "Open" is a verb; "change" is a noun, the proposed change to the project.

bot.activity.openRequest.description: Link on a Homeroom bot activity card for a first version: opens the request the work was done for. "Open" is a verb; "request" is a noun.

bot.activity.requestNumber.description: Link on a Homeroom bot activity card: opens the request the work was done for. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.activity.name.description: Accessible name of a Homeroom bot activity card. Homeroom bot is the assistant's name. {{title}} names the piece of work, for example "Ear Trainer #12: Sort by date".

bot.head.requestNumber.description: Title of the card for a request in a message from Homeroom bot when the request's own title is not known. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.head.firstVersion.description: Subtitle of the project card in a message from Homeroom bot about building a project's first version.

bot.head.notFiled.description: Subtitle of the card for a request Homeroom bot offers to file but has not filed yet. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.ready.title.project.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when a project's first version is built and can be tried. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.ready.title.projectBroken.text: {{project}} is built, but not everything works yet
bot.ready.title.projectBroken.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when a project's first version is built but some of it does not work yet. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.ready.title.unnamed.text: Your project is ready to try
bot.ready.title.unnamed.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when a project's first version is built and can be tried, when the project's name is not known.

bot.ready.title.unnamedBroken.text: Your project is built, but not everything works yet
bot.ready.title.unnamedBroken.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when a project's first version is built but some of it does not work yet, when the project's name is not known.

bot.ready.title.change.text: Your change to {{project}} is ready to try
bot.ready.title.change.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when the change the person asked for is built and can be tried. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.ready.title.changeBroken.text: Your change to {{project}} is built, but not everything works yet
bot.ready.title.changeBroken.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when the change the person asked for is built but some of it does not work yet. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.ready.title.changeUnnamed.text: Your change to Your project is ready to try
bot.ready.title.changeUnnamed.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when the change the person asked for is built and can be tried, when the project's name is not known.

bot.ready.title.changeUnnamedBroken.text: Your change to Your project is built, but not everything works yet
bot.ready.title.changeUnnamedBroken.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when the change the person asked for is built but some of it does not work yet, when the project's name is not known.

bot.ready.broken_one.description: Red line on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card listing what in the built change does not work yet. {{count}} is how many things; {{problems}} is the description of them, as written by the checks. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

bot.ready.broken_other.description: Red line on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card listing what in the built change does not work yet. {{count}} is how many things; {{problems}} is the descriptions of them joined with semicolons.

bot.ready.brokenPair.description: Joins two descriptions of things that do not work yet in the list on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card. {{first}} and {{second}} are each a description written by the checks.

bot.ready.goingLive.description: Tooltip of the spinning ring on Homeroom bot's card while an approved change is being put into use.

bot.ready.youAsked.description: Line on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card. {{request}} is what the person asked the bot for, in their own words.

bot.ready.choices.description: Accessible name of the group of buttons on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card (try it, approve it, ask for changes).

bot.ready.line.live.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change once the change is in use by everyone.

bot.ready.line.goingLive.text: It’s approved and going live now.
bot.ready.line.goingLive.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change that has all its approvals and is being put into use, when there is no release estimate to say instead.

bot.ready.line.withdrawn.text: This change was closed without going live.
bot.ready.line.withdrawn.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change that was closed and never put into use.

bot.ready.line.approved.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change after the reader approved it, when what happens next is not known.

bot.ready.line.stale.text: This change was updated. Try the new version first.
bot.ready.line.stale.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change that was updated after the card was sent: the reader must try the new version before approving.

bot.ready.line.updated.text: This change was updated. Its newer version is below.
bot.ready.line.updated.description: Line on Homeroom bot's older card for a change: a newer card further down the conversation replaces it.

bot.ready.line.closed.description: Line on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card once the card's buttons no longer apply.

bot.ready.line.lookOnly.text: You can try it. Approving it is up to the people building {{project}}.
bot.ready.line.lookOnly.description: Line on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card for someone who asked for a change on a project they do not build on: they can open its preview, but only the project's builders can approve it. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.ready.line.lookOnlyUnnamed.text: You can try it. Approving it is up to the people building this project.
bot.ready.line.lookOnlyUnnamed.description: Line on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card for someone who asked for a change on a project they do not build on, when the card does not know the project's name: they can open its preview, but only the project's builders can approve it.

bot.ready.withdraw.description: Button on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card: has the bot withdraw the change (close it without it going live). Shown to the person who asked for it or the project's owner.

bot.ready.withdrawConfirm.title.description: Title of the confirm dialog after tapping Withdraw it on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card.

bot.ready.withdrawConfirm.message.text: It will be closed without going live, and Homeroom bot leaves a note on its request saying so.
bot.ready.withdrawConfirm.message.description: Body of the confirm dialog after tapping Withdraw it on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card: what withdrawing the change does.

bot.ready.withdrawConfirm.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that withdraws a change from Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card.

bot.ready.approved.soon.text: You approved it. It goes live in a minute or two.
bot.ready.approved.soon.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card after the reader approved a change and nothing else is needed: the change is put into use shortly.

bot.ready.approved.none.none.text: You approved it. It goes live once it has the approvals it needs.

bot.plan.step.description: Progress line under the title of Homeroom bot's plan card. {{step}} is the current step number and {{total}} the number of steps.
