header.subtitle.channel_other.description: Line under the #general channel's name in its header: what the channel is and how many members it has. Homeroom is the product's name. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.invited.description: Line under a conversation's name in its header while you have been invited and have not answered yet.

header.subtitle.group_one.description: Line under a group chat's name in its header: how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.group_other.description: Line under a group chat's name in its header: how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.groupOwner_one.description: Line under a group chat's name in its header, shown to its owner: how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.groupOwner_other.description: Line under a group chat's name in its header, shown to its owner: how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.invitedCount_one.description: Added after the member count under a group chat's name in its header ("2 members · 1 invited"): how many people were asked to join and have not answered yet. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.invitedCount_other.description: Added after the member count under a group chat's name in its header ("2 members · 3 invited"): how many people were asked to join and have not answered yet. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.requestPending.description: Line under a person's name in a direct conversation's header while they have not accepted your message request yet. "Request" is a noun.

header.subtitle.direct.description: Line under a person's name in a direct conversation's header.

header.subtitle.homeroomBot.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of the chat with it: what the bot is for.

header.aiBadge.description: Small badge beside the name in a conversation's header when the other party is an AI assistant rather than a person.

header.groupMembers.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the people button in a group chat's header: opens the list of its members.

header.actions.description: Accessible name of the "…" button in a conversation's header and of the menu it opens.

header.menu.rename.description: Item in a group chat's "…" menu: opens the prompt to change the group's name.

header.menu.members.description: Item in a group chat's "…" menu: opens the dialog listing its members and pending invitations.

header.menu.block.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: stops the other person from messaging you. "Block" is a verb. {{name}} is that person as shown in the header, a username with @.

header.menu.blockUnnamedHandle.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: stops the other person from messaging you. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

header.menu.blockUnnamed.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: stops the other person from messaging you. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

header.menu.blockUnknown.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu when the other person is not known; it is disabled. A verb: stop this person from messaging you.

header.menu.report.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: reports the other person to Homeroom's moderators. "Report" is a verb.

header.menu.botFeedback.description: Item in the "…" menu of the conversation with Homeroom bot, where a person's conversation offers Block and Report: opens the dialog for sending feedback to Homeroom about the bot.

header.menu.refresh.description: Item in a conversation's "…" menu: reloads the conversation from the server.

thread.day.today.description: Divider between messages in a conversation: the messages below were sent today.

thread.day.yesterday.description: Divider between messages in a conversation: the messages below were sent yesterday.

discussion.error.title.text: This discussion could not be opened.
discussion.error.title.description: Heading shown in Messages in place of a project's discussion that failed to open.

discussion.error.body.text: It may have been removed, or you may not be a member of that app.
discussion.error.body.description: Text under "This discussion could not be opened." in Messages.

discussion.subtitle.archived.description: Line under a project's name in the header of its old discussion, which can be read but no longer written in.

discussion.subtitle.channel.description: Line under a project's name in the header of its discussion channel. {{channel}} is the channel's handle; keep the # before it.

discussion.subtitle.everyone.description: Line under a project's name in the header of its discussion when the channel has no handle: who the discussion is for.

agent.sessionName.description: Accessible name of the pane in Messages that shows a working session with a coding agent.

agent.row.prNumber.description: Stands in for the title of a change on a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list. "PR" is the abbreviation of pull request; {{number}} is its number, keep the #.

agent.row.changeId.description: Stands in for the title of a change on a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list when nothing else names it. "Change" is a noun; {{id}} is its number.

agent.row.noChange.description: Second line of a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list when the session is not working on any change. "Change" is a noun.

agent.row.newSession.description: Name of a coding-agent session that has no title yet, on its row in the conversation list.

agent.row.activity.working.description: Read by screen readers right after a coding-agent session's title in the conversation list: the agent is working. Keep the leading comma, which separates it from the title.

agent.row.activity.done.description: Read by screen readers right after a coding-agent session's title in the conversation list: the agent has finished its turn. Keep the leading comma, which separates it from the title.

agent.row.working.description: Second line of a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list while the agent is working.

agent.session.openFull.description: Link above a coding-agent session shown inside Messages: opens the same session on its own full page. "Open" is a verb.

agent.session.unavailable.text: This session could not be opened here.
agent.session.unavailable.description: Error in Messages in place of a coding-agent session that could not be shown inside the Messages screen.

agent.session.openInApp.description: Link under "This session could not be opened here.": opens the session on the project's own page. "Open" is a verb.

agent.session.loading.description: Shown in Messages while a coding-agent session loads.

thread.empty.title.description: Heading in the right-hand pane of Messages on a wide screen while no conversation is open.

thread.empty.body.text: Your chats open here. A community's channel is on its hub, under Communities.
thread.empty.body.description: Text under "Choose a conversation": conversations open in this pane, and a community's channel is found on that community's page in the Communities tab.

thread.showMoreCards_one.description: Accessible name of the button in a conversation that unfolds a run of cards sent one after another. {{count}} is how many cards are hidden.

thread.showMoreCards_other.description: Accessible name of the button in a conversation that unfolds a run of cards sent one after another. {{count}} is how many cards are hidden.

thread.paneName.description: Accessible name of the pane showing a conversation that has no title. A noun.

thread.loading.description: Shown in a conversation while its messages load.

thread.left.description: Shown in place of a group chat's messages after you left it.

thread.backToMessages.description: Button shown where a conversation can no longer be opened: returns to the conversation list. Messages is the screen's name.

thread.emptyConversation.description: Shown in a conversation in which nothing has been written, under a waving hand.

thread.loadingOlder.description: Line at the top of a conversation while earlier messages load after scrolling up.

thread.loadEarlier.description: Button at the top of a conversation, shown only after loading earlier messages failed: tries again.

thread.loadingNewer.description: Label of the "Load newer messages" button while newer messages load.

thread.loadNewer.description: Button at the foot of a conversation opened at an older message: fetches the messages after the ones shown.

thread.jumpToPresent.description: Button at the foot of a conversation opened at an older message: goes straight to the newest messages.

thread.typingOne.description: Line above the message box while one other person is typing. {{name}} is that person's name.

thread.typingOneUnknown.description: Line above the message box while one other person is typing. Used when the person's username is not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.typingTwo.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. {{first}} and {{second}} are the names of two of them.

thread.typingTwoUnknown.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. Used when the usernames of both people typing are not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.typingTwoFirstUnknown.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. Used when the first person's username is not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown. {{second}} is the other person's name.

thread.typingTwoSecondUnknown.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. Used when the second person's username is not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown. {{first}} is the other person's name.

thread.activityTimeRange.description: Time shown on the card of replies made in a thread when they span more than one minute: the time of the first reply and of the last. {{start}} and {{end}} are clock times.

replies.paneName.description: Accessible name of the side pane showing a thread of replies under one message. A noun.

replies.title.description: Title at the top of the side pane showing a thread of replies under one message. A noun.

replies.close.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the X button on the thread side pane: closes the thread and returns to the conversation.

replies.resize.description: Accessible name of the divider between a chat and its open thread on a computer, which is dragged left and right to make the thread narrower or wider.

replies.count_one.description: Divider under the first message in the thread side pane: how many replies the thread has. {{count}} is that number.

replies.count_other.description: Divider under the first message in the thread side pane: how many replies the thread has. {{count}} is that number.

replies.loading.description: Shown in the thread side pane while the replies load.

replies.none.description: Shown in the thread side pane under the first message when nobody has replied.

replies.loadingEarlier.description: Label of the "Load earlier replies" button while earlier replies load.

replies.loadEarlier.description: Button in the thread side pane: fetches the replies before the ones shown.

replies.discussion.from.description: Line under the name of a message from a request's public discussion, shown inside that request's thread in the chat with Homeroom bot: tapping it opens the request page, where the message can be replied to. Used once on each such message.

replies.discussion.more.text: Earlier messages are on the request's discussion
replies.discussion.more.description: Link at the top of a request's thread in the chat with Homeroom bot: the request's public discussion has more messages than the newest ones shown here, and opening it shows them all.

replies.app.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the message box in a thread under a message of a project's channel.

replies.app.membersOnly.text: Only members of this app can reply here.
replies.app.membersOnly.description: Notice in place of the message box in a thread of a project's channel, shown to someone who is not a member of that project.

row.botBlock.requestLabel.description: Read by screen readers only, at the start of a message from Homeroom bot whose request card is not drawn because an earlier message in the same outlined group already shows it: says which request the message is about. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #; {{title}} is the request's title.

row.botBlock.requestLabelUntitled.description: Read by screen readers only, at the start of a message from Homeroom bot whose request card is not drawn because an earlier message in the same outlined group already shows it, when the request's title is not known: says which request the message is about. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.ready.line.release.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release. {{release}} is a finished sentence saying when the change goes live, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)"; this entry adds only the full stop that ends it.

bot.ready.change.request.description: Line under the title of Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card, a link to the change's page when it has one: which request the change is for, then what it is. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #; {{title}} is the change's own title, else the request's.

bot.ready.change.requestUntitled.description: Line under the title of Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card, a link to the change's page when it has one, when there is no title to say beside the number: which request the change is for. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.outcome.goingLiveRelease.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history, for a change to Homeroom itself: the change is built and merged, and waits for the platform's next release. {{release}} is a finished sentence saying when it goes live, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)". Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.plan.complicatedNote.text: Its before and after screens are on the request below. What you ask to change is posted there, where the group can see it.
bot.plan.complicatedNote.description: Note under Homeroom bot's plan card in a conversation, while a complicated change's plan waits: its before and after screens are on the request card below, and what the reader asks to change is posted there for the community to see.

bot.plan.complicatedNoteShown.text: What you ask to change is posted on the request below, where the group can see it.
bot.plan.complicatedNoteShown.description: Note under Homeroom bot's plan card in a conversation, while a complicated change's plan waits and the card itself shows the plan and its before and after screens: what the reader asks to change is posted on the request card below, for the community to see.

bot.plan.spec.see.description: Row on Homeroom bot's plan card for a complicated change: opens the whole plan (what will change and its before and after screens) inside the card. "See" is a verb.

bot.plan.spec.hide.description: The same row on Homeroom bot's plan card once the whole plan is open: folds the plan away again. "Hide" is a verb.

bot.plan.spec.sections.description: Accessible name of the two tabs over the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card.

bot.plan.spec.tab.user.description: Tab over the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card: the half of the plan that says what people will see and do differently. Shown first.

bot.plan.spec.tab.tech.description: Tab over the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card: the half of the plan that says how it will be built, for developers.

bot.plan.spec.tabEmpty.description: Shown in a tab of the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card when that half of the plan is empty.

bot.track.state.queued.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: waiting for the bot to start on it.

bot.track.state.planning.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot is reading the request or writing its plan.

bot.track.state.waiting.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot needs something from the person reading: an answer, a go-ahead, more detail or a look.

bot.track.state.waitingNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot needs something from the person who asked for it (an answer, a go-ahead, more detail), shown to somebody else, on a page anyone can open. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @.

bot.track.state.building.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot is building the change.

bot.track.state.checks.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the change's automated checks are running or have just run.

bot.track.state.vote.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the change is waiting for the group's approval.

bot.track.state.going_live.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the change was approved and is being made live.

bot.track.state.live.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the change is live.

bot.track.state.held.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the request is ready but held back by a limit.

bot.track.state.stopped.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot stopped working on it.

bot.track.state.done_elsewhere.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: somebody else's change shipped what the request asked for.

bot.track.state.closed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the request was closed.

bot.track.step.plan.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Plan" step.

bot.track.step.build.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Build" step.

bot.track.step.checks.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Checks" step.

bot.track.step.vote.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Vote" step.

bot.track.step.live.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under one of the five segments of a request's progress bar (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live). This one is the "Live" step.

bot.track.step.buildTry.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label under the Build segment of a request's progress bar when the bot is building it again: its checks failed or voters asked for changes, so this is a later try. {{number}} is which try, 2 or more.

bot.track.try.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Small note after the status word of a request the bot is working on again, for example "Building · Try 2". {{number}} is which try, 2 or more.

bot.track.soFar.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. How long this try has been running. {{duration}} is a short duration such as "15m" or "2h 5m". Only this try is counted, never an earlier one.

bot.track.line.queued.turn.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "queued" when the reason is "turn".

bot.track.line.queued.queue.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "queued" when the reason is "queue".

bot.track.line.queued.build_turn.text: Ready to build, waiting its turn
bot.track.line.queued.build_turn.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "queued" when the reason is "build_turn".

bot.track.line.queued.next.text: Ready to build, next in line
bot.track.line.queued.next.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "queued" when the reason is "next".

bot.track.line.queued.first_version_pend.text: Waiting for the project's first version
bot.track.line.queued.first_version_pend.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "queued" when the reason is "first_version_pending".

bot.track.line.queued.project_busy.text: Waiting for the project's other builds to finish
bot.track.line.queued.project_busy.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "queued" when the reason is "project_busy".

bot.track.line.queued.project_building.text: Waiting for the project's other builds to finish
bot.track.line.queued.project_building.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "queued" when the reason is "project_building".

bot.track.line.queued.person_limit.text: Waiting for your other requests to finish
bot.track.line.queued.person_limit.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "queued" when the reason is "person_limit".

bot.track.line.planning.reading.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "planning" when the reason is "reading".

bot.track.line.planning.planning.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "planning" when the reason is "planning".

bot.track.line.planning.setting_up.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "planning" when the reason is "setting_up".

bot.track.line.planning.answered.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "planning" when the reason is "answered".

bot.track.line.waiting.question.text: It has a question for you
bot.track.line.waiting.question.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "question".

bot.track.line.waiting.questionNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "question", shown to somebody other than the person it waits on. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @.

bot.track.line.waiting.plan.text: Its plan is ready for you to say Build it
bot.track.line.waiting.plan.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "plan".

bot.track.line.waiting.planNamed.text: Its plan is ready for @{{username}} to say Build it
bot.track.line.waiting.planNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "plan", shown to somebody other than the person it waits on. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @. "Build it" is the name of the button that person taps: keep it as the button reads.

bot.track.line.waiting.detail.text: It can't build this as written: add detail
bot.track.line.waiting.detail.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "detail".

bot.track.line.waiting.detailNamed.text: It can't build this as written: it needs more detail from @{{username}}
bot.track.line.waiting.detailNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "detail", shown to somebody other than the person it waits on. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @.

bot.track.line.waiting.look.text: Built: it needs you to look before it goes up for a vote
bot.track.line.waiting.look.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "look".

bot.track.line.waiting.lookNamed.text: Built: it needs @{{username}} to look before it goes up for a vote
bot.track.line.waiting.lookNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "waiting" when the reason is "look", shown to somebody other than the person it waits on. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @.

bot.track.line.building.default.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Line under a request's title saying where it is and why, for the state "building".

bot.track.line.building.reviewing.text: Checking its screens and fixing what it finds
bot.track.line.building.reviewing.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page.
